definitions.gloss: preliminary sketch; underdrawing; design (for a craft)
definitions.explanation: The drawing made first, under or before the finished work: in pencil under a painting, or as the pattern for embroidery, woodblock prints, lacquer or dyeing.

examples.japanese: {下絵|したえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{下絵|したえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: Draw an underdrawing in pencil, then add the color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刺繍|ししゅう}→刺繍：05411_shishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下絵|したえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{写|うつ}して→写す：01227_utsusu⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧がしやすい。
examples.english: Before embroidering, transferring the design onto the cloth makes the work easier.
